rv.q: Sunny Afternoon is a hymn to English musical individualism and artistic perseverance - all with the miniskirts and freshness of 1960s London.
And still it works fantastically well.
Sunny Afternoon offers a worthwhile experience for fans of rock music, particularly for those who appreciate the Kinks. It delivers solid performances and a nostalgic look at the band’s history.
This feels like a cartoon depiction of a band at the forefront of the politics, music, and culture of the time

cn.t: Critics hail this Kinks musical as a "blazing triumph" and "blaster of a show," praising its powerful energy and the band's compelling story of determination against industry pressures.
